question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a grey ball, Bob has a pink ball, and Claire has a silver ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Bob swap balls. Then, Alice and Bob swap balls. Finally, Alice and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) grey ball
(B) pink ball
(C) silver ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (grey, pink, silver)
1. Claire and Bob swap: (grey, silver, pink)
2. Alice and Bob swap: (silver, grey, pink)
3. Alice and Claire swap: (pink, grey, silver)
Bob has the grey ball, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
